# Welcome to MarkBangla

MarkBangla is a modern, high-performance Markdown editor and PDF exporter with real-time live preview, elegant typography presets, and cloud sharing capabilities.

All your documents remain **privately stored on your computer** by default. Use the top toolbar to switch views, export to PDF, or generate a public share link.

## Key Features

- **Split Pane Workspace**: Resizable dual-view editor with live synchronized preview.
- **Diagrams & Flowcharts**: Instant SVG rendering from `mermaid` code blocks.
- **Typography & Themes**: 8 bespoke styles including Classic Serif, Modern Clean, Academic Paper, and Dark Obsidian.
- **Custom Font Support**: Upload your own TTF, OTF, or WOFF fonts anytime.
- **Zero Lock-in Export**: Download high-fidelity vector PDFs or raw `.md` files.
- **Cloud Sharing**: Generate secure public links with transparent privacy controls.

### Quick Checklist

- [x] Write rich Markdown with GitHub-flavored tables & task lists
- [x] Render real-time Mermaid diagrams
- [x] Resize or hide panels with the interactive center handle
- [x] Print or export directly to clean A4 / Letter PDF
- [ ] Write something extraordinary today!
